title: Rename apply undo confirmation honest progress
summary: Added an undo confirmation step, operation-aware undo result messaging, and truthful in-flight command activity for synchronous rename apply/undo commands.
reason: Undo was available but posted immediately without the same confirmation affordance as apply, and the in-flight UI reused an indeterminate progress bar that looked like file progress even though the backend command is synchronous.
behavior_before: Undo Last Apply immediately posted /api/rename/undo, undo completion reused apply-oriented result copy, and apply/undo in-flight states could leave or render progress bars that implied row-level progress.
behavior_after: Undo Last Apply opens a compact confirmation modal, canceling undo does not post to the backend, confirmed undo shows a command activity state while waiting, and final apply/undo results render only after backend evidence is returned.
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView rename confirmation/activity/result changes and the focused smoke/static test assertions; backend rename apply/undo routes and schemas are unchanged.
notes:
